findings.summary: An invented quote is used as the evidence for O1's `built` status.
findings.evidence: The row cites D46: "With them the design was accepted". A search of all *.md files finds this text only in requirements-map.md itself. D46 (docs/decisions.md:1004) is "Each job builds in its own directories" and says nothing about accepting v0. The fact is true, because athena-v0.md's status line says "accepted", but the citation is fabricated. This breaks criterion 7 and the evidence default. Fix: cite the status line of docs/design/athena-v0.md instead.

findings.summary: Off-by-one line citation for the brief's permission to use GitHub features.
findings.evidence: The doc cites BRIEF.md line 130. The GitHub-features permission is on line 129; line 130 is the ban on pushing upstream.

summary: The candidate adds docs/design/requirements-map.md plus small entries in README.md, CHANGELOG.md and decisions.md (D82). It meets the request almost entirely. The map has 39 rows, one per brief ID and addendum, with statuses from a defined vocabulary, owning designs that exist on disk, and no invented job ids. It specifies the strategy view in five parts with sources, pushback, a data shape and regeneration, and a roadmap that puts M1 first and covers the move-the-study-up addendum. It also lists alternatives and what is out of scope. BRIEF.md is untouched and fmt and tests pass. Spot-checking the citations against the files shows most are accurate. One is not: O1's `built` status quotes D46 as saying "With them the design was accepted", but that text exists nowhere in the repository, and D46 is about per-job build directories. An invented quote presented as a (read) citation fails criterion 7 and the evidence default, so the verdict is fail. The fix is one line: cite the "accepted" status line of athena-v0.md instead.
